items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: Willie Gerbrecht said he'd give me a hand so I'd play a number and he'd play a number.

ctx.x: Yeah. You have down here about the steam of President.

Well I had played on the steam of President and I was going real good until I told the Captain I quit. So the night I quit I took another trumpet player on because just nothing wasn't coming out the horn. And Willie Gerbrecht said he'd give me a hand so I'd play a number and he'd play a number. But I let Willie play as much as he wanted to. And it was about five years before I contacted him. I've been playing off and on when the other band takes off.
